chapter.verse: Theofilas aw, Zeisu in ama teelsa sawltakte Kha Siangtho tawh a vaikhak khit ciangin,
a tunglam a kilaktoh ni dong matengin a bawlsa leh a thuhilh khempeuh, a masa lai sungah ka gelh zo hi.
Tua Zeisu in gimna a thuak khit ciangin amau kiangah ni sawmli tawntung kilangin, hihna tampi tawh a nungta taktak ahihna lak a, Pasian’ Gam thu a hilh hi.
Tua sawltakte tawh a omkhawm lai takin, Jerusalem khuapi panin paikhia loin, “Keimah kiangah na zaksa uh Pa’ kamciamna letsong na ngak un.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Johan in tui sungah hong baptaiz hi. Ahih hangin a sawt loin note in Kha Siangtho sungah na kibaptaiz ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Amaute a kikhop lai takun, “Topa aw, tu lai takin Israel mipawlte in amau gam na ki-uksak kik ding hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Pa in ama ukna-ah a koihsa a hun ahi zongin, a ni ahi zongin na theih nadingun thu a om kei hi.

Ahih hangin Kha Siangtho in nomau tungah hong kumsuk khit ciangin vangliatna na ngah ding uh a, Jerusalem khua-a kipan Judah gam, Samaria gam khempeuh leh leimong dongin ka teci na hi ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua thu a gen khit ciangin sawltakte in a et lai takun, Zeisu vantung lamah kilato a, amau in a muh loh nadingun meii khat in a liah hi.
Zeisu a paito amaute in vantungah a et cian lai takun, mi nih in puanpaak silhin amau kiangah dingin,
“Galile mite aw, bang hangin vantung lam ento na hi uh hiam? Note kiang pan vantungah a kilato Zeisu in vantungah a pai na muh uh bangin khatvei hong kumsuk kik ding hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jerusalem khua tawh kinai, Nipi ni pai theih tan a gamla Oliv Mual panin sawltakte Jerusalem khua-ah a paikik uh hi.
A tun’ uh ciangin Piter, Johan, Jeim leh Andru, Filip leh Thomas, Bartholomai leh Mattiu, Alfe-as’ tapa Jeim, Simon Zealot leh Jeim’ tapa Judas-te a tun’na uh inndei tungah a paito uh hi.
Tua mi khempeuhte in Zeisu’ nu Mari a kipan numeite leh Zeisu’ sanggamte tawh lungsim kikhatin thu a ngen niloh uh hi.
Tua lai takin mi za leh sawmnihte a kikhop lai takun, Piter in amau laizang ah ding-a

“Ute naute aw, Zeisu a man mite lam hilhpa Judas Iskariot thu Kha Siangtho in David’ kam sung panin thu hong genkholh Lai Siangtho sungah a om thu a tun’ nading a om hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, amah in kote tawh kisimkhawm a, thuhilhna za a ngah zo hi.
(Tua pa in a gilohna thaman tawh lo khat a lei khit ciangin, a bungbu-in kia a, a gilpi kitamin a gil khempeuh a buakhia hi.
Tua thute Jerusalem khua-ah mite in a zak uh ciangin amau kam in tua lo “Akeldama” ci uh a, tua in “Sisan’ Lo” a cihnopna hi).
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh: “Ama omna mundai suak hen, Ama omna-ah kuamah teeng kei hen,” cih leh, “Ama za midang khat in ngah ta hen,” ci-in Late Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Johan’ baptaizna pana kipan Topa Zeisu in eite tawh a kikhen ni dongin, a sungah a lutkhawm, a pusuak khawm lai takin,
kote tawh a tawntung a kikhawl mite sung panin khat in kote tawh Zeisu’ thawhkikna thu teci a suak ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin mi nih, Barsabbas kici, a mindang Justas ahi Josef leh Matthias a teel uh hi.
“Mi khempeuh’ lungsim a thei Topa aw,
Judas in ama omna phualah pai dingin thuhilh-za leh sawltak-za pan tawp kik a, tua za a ngah dingin hih mi nih lakah na teel penpen hong lak in,” ci-in thu a nget khit uh ciangin lai-ai a san uh a,
Matthias in a ngah ciangin sawltak sawm-le-khatte tawh a kisimkhawm hi.
